name: kagerou-oboro
author: BlaXun
description: Kagerou and Oboro in pre-renewal. A Ninja at 99/70 is reborn as a Novice, becomes a Ninja again with transcendent stat points, and from Ninja job 50 becomes a Kagerou or Oboro. The skills are scaled to sit a little below the transcendent classes, and four tiers of Kagerou/Oboro equipment (levels 50 to 95) drop from monsters.
